name: Blind Spot Car Mirror Set
description: Never miss a thing with these high-quality, wide-angle blind-spot mirrors. Perfect for cars, trucks, and SUVs. Easy peel-and-stick installation. Shatterproof design with durable ABS frame. Eliminates dangerous blind spots and enhances safety while driving, parking, and reversing.

name: Magnetic Suction Car Phone Mount
description: Effortless phone mounting with a powerful magnetic grip. Securely holds your phone on dashboard or windshield without messy adhesives. Fully adjustable with 360° rotation for the perfect viewing angle. One-handed operation for quick phone placement and removal. Universal compatibility with all smartphones. Sleek, compact design that complements any car interior.

name: Fuzzy Leopard Steering Wheel Cover Set
description: Add a touch of wild style to your car with this adorable leopard print steering wheel cover set. Made from soft, fuzzy material for extra comfort and grip. Includes steering wheel cover, seat belt covers, and gear shift cover. Elastic band ensures snug fit on most steering wheels. Easy to install and clean. Brighten up your car interior with this fun and fashionable accessory.
